module: Module 3: Fractional Lot Rounding & Remainder Allocation
title: Remainder Handling on Partial Order Close
precondition: 10.0 lot order closed by 50% (5.0 lots closed); child orders have odd lot sizes.
expected_result: Remainder logic applies to closing volume symmetrically; remaining child positions sum to exactly 5.00 lots.
actual_result: Partial close remainder logic applied symmetrically. Remaining child volume: [1.67, 1.66, 1.66], sum = 4.99.
